title: Realizing prescribed coefficients as a homogeneous binary form
statement: For every natural number n and every function a : ℕ → ℂ, there exists P ∈ BinaryForm ℂ n such that, for every exponent index d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, coeff d P equals a(d(0)) when d(0)+d(1)=n, and equals zero otherwise.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ), ∃ P : ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n), ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, MvPolynomial.coeff d P.val = if d 0 + d 1 = n then a (d 0) else 0
